title: Rework of held pull requests, proposed by a Claude Code cloud session
summary: Instructions for a Claude Code scheduled task, started when the automated review labels a pull request review-held: it fixes the blocking findings on a branch of its own and opens a pull request into the held one, for a human to merge; two attempts, then needs-human.
postInstall: Read docs/conventions/claude-rework.md: the scheduled task is created in Claude Code on the web, not by this installer.
Create the repository labels review-held and needs-human.
Never run live by the kit's authors: hold a throwaway pull request on purpose and watch the first rework.
